title: Jim Torres Racing - reproduction 935 flat fan assembly (for sale)
notes: Sells a copy of the factory 935 flat fan: fan machined from 7075 aluminium (the 934 fans were heavier castings), aluminium stator option with two-piece housing or one-piece fibreglass housing, gear drive fed by an oil distribution tree and banjo bolt, gears run in between 2,000 and 8,500 rpm for 60-90 minutes, external Bosch alternator on its own belt. USD 25,000 base. No diameter, blade count, airflow or power data.
